name: 戻る操作と中央見出しのナビゲーション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0015 戻る操作と中央見出しのナビゲーション.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact navigation header strip, original region0,60,390,56 normalized. Exact only Japanese text ナビゲーション centered in the FULL header width, Meiryo Bold14px/24px, tracking0. A small left-pointing back chevron at far left with16px logical inset. Original source controls glyph: compact two-stroke left chevron with moderate optical stroke weight, height about18logicalpx and narrow width10px, NOT mock's oversized wide thin less-than symbol. Use slate#526173 back glyph, ink#1D1D1D title. Keep white surface and pure-white canvas, restrained soft downward separation and only subtle toolbar rounding if present. No colored back circle or fill, no forest-green accent, no right action, no phone/status bar or extra content. Preserve compact390x56logical strip and source fine alignment. Uniform enlargement into a readable wide1536x512 output with restrained margins. Center title independently of back button.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No accent justified: ordinary navigation icon stays consistent slate and title ink on white. No primary brand action exists in this header.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/mock目視。mockのwideなless-thanを原版に近いコンパクトなback chevronへ修正。通常ナビゲーションはaccent不要と判断。生成後にナビゲーション文字、full幅中央、左glyph、白面、余計なactionなしを確認。操作/font同一性/native編集/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
